Elijah uses the word with irony at Carmel (1 Kgs 18:27), suggesting Baal may be deep in thought. Spanish 'meditacion' and German 'meditation' reflect this reflective, non-distressed sense.
    Existing Spanish translations: meditación, mi-meditación
